name: Idle Asterix
summary:
WELCOME CHIEF!
In Idle Asterix you manage your own village, hire workers to get resources and upgrade your brave Gauls like Asterix and Obelix to succeed in adventures like the rescue of poor Dogmatix, who has been captured by the Romans.

As gaulish Chief, you are faced by multiple challenges:
- Idle mechanics: Hire overseers to automate the production. Your workers automatically produce sesterces even if you are not in the game
- Improve your production so that your workers collect even more sesterces for you
- Unlock famous Gaulish heroes and fight against the Romans to unlock more production fields while traversing through Gaul
- Tinker with new and epic bonuses to help you in your battle against the Romans
- You can use your finger to actively join the fight
